en.name: EventSpark
en.subtitle: Find events, run events
en.description:
EventSpark is both sides of an event.

GOING
Discover what is on near you or in a city you pick, filter it down, and save what you like. Buy into a tier, keep the ticket in the app, and follow the agenda for the day. Some events run a live video room you can join from the listing.

HOSTING
Create an event, set your ticket tiers, and manage it from your phone. Check attendees in at the door, see who has arrived, and read the analytics afterwards.

YOURS
Saved events, tickets and your profile stay on your device unless you are signed in to a host account.
